crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know…
In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that…
Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is…
“All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and…
to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

translations.web: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
translations.bsb: But God understands its way, and He knows its place.
translations.kjv: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place
translations.asv: God understandeth the way thereof, And he knoweth the place thereof.
